## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue when relevant.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. For routing changes, separate type matching from an actual Finder preview and identify the provider used.

- [ ] Relevant Swift / JavaScript / Python checks pass, or limitations are explained.
- [ ] Generated resources and type declarations are updated when their sources change.
- [ ] New or adapted third-party code includes its source, revision and license notices.

Mention any changes to sandbox permissions, local resource access or existing file associations.
